caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP synergy rows include FICI fields, but local primary XML/PDF/supplement sources report MIC potentiation tables rather than explicit FICI values; the underlying peptide/organism/novobiocin evidence is source-located while FICI remains database-derived.
Mechanistic claims are bounded to in silico docking/MD plus MIC potentiation; no local direct membrane-permeability, LPS-binding, or efflux inhibition assay was found.
Primary activity tables use NP and NT as reported outcomes; these are retained as raw qualitative values rather than converted to numeric MICs.
